To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
steam flaking corn improves the energy value of corn and the efficiency of feedlot cattle.
steam flaking corn increases starch digestion and energy value and that the UIP value of supplemental CSM is reduced by steam flaking.
steam flaking corn increased starch digestion in the rumen and total tract and increased the energy value of corn-based finishing diets for feed-lot cattle.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the feeding value of DRC and SFC in diets fed to finishing cattle.
the influence of dietary CP level on the feeding value and digestibility of DRC and SFC.
the influence of dietary energy level on the feeding value and digestibility of dry-rolled corn (DRC) vs steam-flaked corn.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

steam flaking corn increased starch digestion, increased energy content of the diet, and improved feed efficiency, whereas CSM supplementation decreased feed efficiency and energy content of the diets.
steam flaking corn improves the feeding value of a high-concentrate finishing diet by increasing starch digestion and energy value of the ration.

steam-flaking corn increases the energy value of a corn-based diet by increasing postruminal starch digestion, whereas supplemental CSM does not increase postruminal digestion of starch and does not increase the energy value of corn-based diets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
steam flaking corn increases its energy value, but the effect on the efficiency of energy utilization is dependent on the level of supplemental protein.
steam flaking corn increased the feeding value of a corn-based diet, but that the increase was less than expected.
steam flaking corn increases starch digestion and the energy value of corn-based diets for feedlot finishing cattle.
The main takeaway from our work is that
steam flaking corn increases the energy value of a high-grain finishing diet by increasing the rate and extent of starch digestion.
steam flaking corn will increase starch digestion, the energy value of corn, and efficiency of feed utilization in finishing diets.
the energy value of a diet can be improved by steam flaking corn, and this is not influenced by the level of protein supplementation.
